sha256Scope: Original v3.1.0-alpha.1 release assets, before the upstream updates and local patches listed below.

upstreamUpdates.summary: Select the EEVEE engine identifier for Blender 4.2–4.x and 5.0+; this fix is not part of a newer upstream release.

patches: Explicit Blender initialization order, disable embedded autoexec, Python error exit code 20.
Reject browser Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site and non-loopback Host on HTTP and WebSocket.
Set frame_step=1 and use_file_extension=True only in the background render process for contiguous PNG sequences.
Remove the unsupported glTF validator runner, dispatch path and operation catalog entry.
Require independent per-launch 256-bit credentials for all HTTP routes and addon WebSocket upgrades; fail closed without configuration.
Add a nonpersistent pairing field and authenticated WebSocket transport to the bundled Blender extension; hide DSH-only UI actions.
Apply fps/fps_base and native resolution percentage only in background renders, and remove gateway credentials from their environment.
